block.isekai_mahou.faction_board.hint: The faction's quests, unlocked by reputation.
command.isekai_mahou.guild.bad_class: Invalid class (warrior, archer, mage, rogue, cleric).
command.isekai_mahou.guild.bad_rank: Invalid rank. Use F, E, D, C, B, A or S.
command.isekai_mahou.guild.complete: Active quest objectives completed (items still need to be delivered).
command.isekai_mahou.guild.hunt.none: No active hunting quest (without an area) for that.
I can hit an apple at fifty paces.
The wind is good for shooting today.
If you see harpy feathers, let me know.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.bye.2: Come back when you need a sword.
May the Dawn light your path.
Hurt? Stay close to me, I'll take care of it.
The undead hate my light. The feeling is mutual.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.cold: The Guild doesn't speak well of you. Better move along.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.farewel: It was a good journey. Until next time!
Contract fulfilled. Look for me at the Guild.
Time to move on. Take care!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.friendl: Hey, colleague! The Guild has been speaking well of you.
Need a hand? I charge little for friends.
Good to see you around again.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.general: They say there's an Elemental Plane beyond the portals.
Ever seen a talking slime? Me neither. Yet.
Always bring extra food on an expedition.
This beats my old life, you know?
The Guild receptionist is the scariest person I know.
I ranked up last week! I still can't believe it.
Herb gathering again... someone has to do it.
The goblins have been more organized lately.
I'm spending all my coins on potions.
Have you heard of the elemental shrines?
One day I'll face a Guardian.
Beware the cultists. They really cast spells.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.hire.ac: Leave it to me. Nobody lays a finger on you.
Three days of adventure? You're on!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.hire.no: No coins, no sword. Nothing personal.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.hire.re: With your reputation at the Guild? Not for all the gold in the Kingdom.
Three more days? Great, I was enjoying it.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.hire.to: You already have too many people following you. I don't work in crowds.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.hired.0: I'm with you. Point and I strike.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.hired.1: If it gets ugly, shout. I'll be there.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.hired.2: A contract is a contract. Count on me.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.hired.3: Ever thought of hiring one more? Just kidding... or not.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.hired.4: I've still got breath for another ten fights.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.hired.5: Sneak and click me: I'll wait here. Again: I'll follow.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.hired_o: I'm already hired. Talk to me when the contract ends.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.honored: It's you! The veterans talk about you in the taverns.
It would be an honor to fight at your side.
I'll make a special price for someone like you.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.levelup: Rank %s! I knew this day would come!
I've reached Rank %s! Thanks for trusting me.
Rank %s... and I'm just warming up.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.mage.0: I'm studying a new glyph. It still explodes sometimes.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.mage.1: Have you written your own chant yet?
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.mage.2: Meditating near bookshelves speeds up your studies.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.night.0: The night is dangerous. Stay near the light.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.night.1: Did you hear that? I think there are zombies nearby.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.peer: Rank %s too? Good luck with your quests!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.respect: Rank %s?! It's an honor to meet you!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.rogue.0: I saw nothing. I heard nothing.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.rogue.1: Chests that bite... always check twice.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.rumor.0: They say the Capital, Aldória, lies close to where every hero arrives.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.rumor.1: There's an alley in the cities where a fence buys anything. Look for the hidden door.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.rumor.2: The Academy pays well for anyone who triggers elemental reactions. Mad scientist stuff.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.rumor.3: The Church of the Dawn hunts the undead tirelessly. And pays in gold.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.rumor.4: The Horde has been prowling around the cities. The Kingdom rewards those who face it.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.rumor.5: Clerics heal, mages blow things up. A good party has both.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.rumor.6: I heard a mage called down a meteor and left a crater the size of a village.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.rumor.7: The forest fairies remember who protects the woods.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.senior: When you reach Rank %s, we'll go on a quest together.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.unregis: No card? Go to the Guild and register!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.wait: I'll wait here. Come back soon.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.adventurer.warrior: A good sword and a sturdy shield. That's all I need.
Stay behind me when the fight starts!
This scar? A hobgoblin. He's worse off.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.master.ambient.0: In my day, we hunted dragons with a wooden sword.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.master.ambient.1: I lost this eye to a harpy. She lost a lot more.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.master.ambient.2: A rank isn't given. It's earned.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.master.ambient.5: The Twilight approaches. I feel it in my bones.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.master.max_rank: Rank S, %s. I have nothing left to teach you.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.master.not_ready: Not yet. Earn more points on the board.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.master.not_yet: You haven't fulfilled the trial yet.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.master.promoted: From this day on, you are Rank %s!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.master.ready: You are ready for the Rank %s trial.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.master.trial_given: So be it. Return victorious or don't return.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.master.unregistere: Hm. Register with the receptionist first, rookie.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.receptionist.ambie: New quests appear on the board every day!
Remember: three quests at a time, at most.
The Guild Master runs the promotion trials.
Need potions? The Guild shop has them.
I heard the Goblin King is back...
Come back in one piece, okay?
dialogue.isekai_mahou.receptionist.bough: Thank you for your purchase! Use it wisely.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.receptionist.ready: %s! I see you finished a request. Shall we log it?
dialogue.isekai_mahou.receptionist.regis: All set, %s! Here's your Adventurer Card. Rank F, for now!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.receptionist.turn_: Excellent work, %s! Here is your reward.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.receptionist.welco: Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild! Would you like to register?
Good to see you, %s! There are new quests on the board.
guild.isekai_mahou.hunt.cleared: ✔ %s cleared! The hunt's spoils went to your bag.
guild.isekai_mahou.hunt.done_elsewhere: You've hunted enough: the %s was dismissed.
guild.isekai_mahou.hunt.exhausted: The %s is exhausted: no more creatures will come. Finish the quest hunting around the world.
guild.isekai_mahou.hunt.expired: The %s dispersed (time ran out). The quest goes on: hunt the creatures wherever you find them.
guild.isekai_mahou.hunt.leaving: You are leaving the Hunting Ground: new waves only come when you return (at %s blocks the creatures retreat).
guild.isekai_mahou.hunt.marked: ⚑ The Guild marked the %s, %s blocks to the %s.
guild.isekai_mahou.hunt.marked_hint: Follow the tracker arrow (J). When you get there, the quest's creatures will come in waves.
guild.isekai_mahou.hunt.no_place: The Guild found no tracks nearby: hunt these creatures wherever you find them.
guild.isekai_mahou.hunt.no_room: No room for the creatures to appear here: move to open ground.
guild.isekai_mahou.hunt.peaceful: On Peaceful difficulty no monsters come to the Hunting Ground.
guild.isekai_mahou.hunt.retreat: You left the %s — the creatures retreated. Come back to continue the hunt.
guild.isekai_mahou.hunt.start: ⚔ The creatures sensed you... Get ready!
guild.isekai_mahou.target.legends: the Ender Dragon or the Warden
guild.isekai_mahou.target.sovereigns: the Abyss Sovereign or the Seraph
guild.isekai_mahou.target.v08.kingpin: the Ender Dragon or the Warden
guild.isekai_mahou.tracker.next_rank_hin: Take quests at the Board (Guild points)
guild.isekai_mahou.tracker.ready: ✔ Ready! Turn in at the Board or Reception
guild.isekai_mahou.tracker.ready_faction: ✔ Ready! Turn in at the %s Board
guild.isekai_mahou.tracker.trial_report: ✔ Done! Report to the Guild Master
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.a_abyss_descent: Set foot in the Abyss and live to report.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.a_ancient_echoe: Descend into the deep in silence. A lot of silence.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.a_elemental_tri: Clear rank III or higher Trials in three different elements.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.a_end_city.desc: Explore an End city and bring back shulker shells.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.a_end_expeditio: Travel to the End and face the endermen.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.a_fallen_master: Mages lost to their own ambition. Stop one of them.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.a_guardian_chal: The Elemental Guardians test those who dare enter their temples.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.a_labyrinth.des: No one returns from the labyrinth. Be the first.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.a_reborn_flames: A lesser phoenix is setting the Elemental Plane ablaze.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.a_sea_elder.des: The monument's elder curses the miners.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.a_sentinel_brea: Defeat two Trial Sentinels. The shield only guards the front: strike from the flanks!
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.a_storm_wings.d: A storm wyvern brought down an airship.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.a_trial_catacly: Clear a rank V or higher Trial and beat the Guardian in the arena.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.a_triple_ruin.d: Someone summoned the Wither. The Guild needs you.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.a_void_crawlers: Something is crawling out of the Abyss rifts.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.academy_counter: Answer three enemy castings with a Counterspell. The board wants to see the stack collapse.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.academy_electro: Soak your targets, then strike with Lightning. Record five Electrocutions.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.academy_essence: A sample of each base essence for the library catalogue.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.academy_legend_: Cast a Legendary Spell before the archivists. The Academy will record every rune.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.academy_mana_cr: The tower's catalysts are drained. Deliver Mana Crystals.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.academy_overloa: Burning + Lightning without blowing up the tower. Mostly.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.academy_reactio: Trigger elemental reactions (Wet + Lightning, Burning + Ice...) for the Academy's research.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.academy_study_e: The Academy wants field data on Earth glyphs. Cast and take notes.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.academy_study_f: The Academy wants field data on Fire glyphs. Cast and take notes.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.academy_study_w: The Academy wants field data on Water glyphs. Cast and take notes.
The Academy wants field data on Wind glyphs. Cast and take notes.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.academy_thermal: Melt and freeze enemies for the arcane thermodynamics chair.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.academy_trial_e: Prove your mastery in an Elemental Trial of rank II or higher.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.academy_trial_m: Rank III+ Trials in three different elements. A feat worthy of a professorship.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.b_ancient_debri: The master smith wants to forge a legendary blade.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.b_avatar_slayer: Defeat three Elemental Avatars. Watch the circles on the ground!
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.b_beyond_the_ve: Cross into the Elemental Plane and come back to tell the tale.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.b_black_bones.d: The smiths want skulls... and fewer wither skeletons.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.b_chamber_marat: Clear three Trials (repeated Challenges count too).
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.b_elemental_fur: Greater elementals are tearing the veil between worlds.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.b_gargoyles.des: The gargoyles of the ruined cathedral have awakened.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.b_ghast_tears.d: Ghasts are bombarding the Guild outpost in the Nether.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.b_orc_lord.desc: The Orc Lord has declared war. Take the fight to him.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.b_ruined_bastio: Raid a bastion and defeat its brutes.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.b_stone_gaze.de: A basilisk turned a patrol into statues.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.b_treacherous_c: Adventurers vanish in dungeons: chests with teeth.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.b_trial_chamber: Test your skills in the underground chambers.
Clear a rank IV or higher Trial.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.b_woodland_mans: They say the mansion holds illager secrets.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.c_arcane_farm.d: The Guild buys the output of your magic farms: 150 Runic Pedestal casts.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.c_arcane_supply: The Guild mages are studying an ancient seal.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.c_berserkers.de: Orc berserkers feel no pain. Be careful.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.c_dark_cult.des: Cultists are preparing a forbidden ritual. Disrupt it.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.c_diamond_order: A noble has commissioned a new crown.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.c_full_moon.des: Howls under the full moon. The werewolves are hunting.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.c_goblin_fortre: The Goblin King has rallied the tribes again. Bring him down.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.c_harpy_nest.de: Harpies are snatching children in the mountains.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.c_hill_ogre.des: An ogre is devouring the region's cattle.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.c_living_flames: Blazes are out of control near the portal.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.c_nether_expedi: Find a Nether fortress and bring back blaze rods.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.c_nether_quartz: Bring Nether quartz for the glassmaker.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.c_sunken_monume: Investigate an ocean monument and its guardians.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.c_trial_fluidit: Clear a rank III or higher Trial.
A troll charges a toll at the bridge. Fire helps against its regeneration.
Clear Trials of two different elements.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.church_dawn_cru: Carry the light to the end of the world: a hundred and fifty undead and the Ruin itself.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.church_great_ti: The cathedral's stained glass cracked. A generous offering pays the restoration.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.church_holy_wat: Glowstone dust and golden carrots for the sisters' potions.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.church_lich.des: The Lich defies death and the Dawn. End its unlife.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.church_light_ri: Purify creatures with Light magic, as the Dawn's rites command.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.church_phantom_: Phantoms torment the sleepless faithful. Shoot them down.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.church_rest_for: The dead cannot rest. Help them — and the Dawn may forgive you.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.church_tithe.de: A donation for the Church's orphanage and infirmary.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.church_undead_p: Graveyards and ruins are infested. Return the dead to the earth.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.church_witch_hu: Witches and cultists corrupt the villages. The Dawn asks for justice.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.church_wither_b: Wither skeletons are walking heresy. Purify the Nether fortress.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.d_avatar_duel.d: Defeat an Elemental Avatar at the end of a Trial — alone or helping a friend.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.d_desert_secret: Find a desert pyramid and report what you saw.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.d_drowned_coast: Drowned are attacking fishermen on the beach.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.d_goblin_shaman: Goblin shamans have learned glyph magic. Stop them.
The Guild treasurer needs to refill the vault.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.d_hobgoblins.de: Hobgoblins are leading the border raids.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.d_jungle_temple: An explorer vanished near a jungle temple. Find it.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.d_king_slime.de: A giant slime wearing a crown? Not a joke. Defeat it.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.d_lizardmen.des: Lizardmen have expanded their swamp territory.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.d_mana_crystals: The Guild needs crystals for its teleport circles.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.d_orc_scouts.de: Orcs are spying on human villages.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.d_outpost.desc: Locate an illager outpost and weaken its garrison.
Illagers are attacking the trade caravans.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.d_runic_pedesta: Put a Spell Scroll on a Runic Pedestal and let it cast 30 times.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.d_trial_adept.d: Clear a rank II or higher Trial.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.d_wolf_riders.d: Goblins riding wolves are terrorizing the roads.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.e_arcane_essenc: The mages' tower needs arcane essence.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.e_chamber_train: The Guild pays those who train in the Trial Chambers. Clear one, of any element.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.e_creeper_contr: Creepers blew up half the village wall. Again.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.e_goblin_archer: Goblin archers are shooting at anyone crossing the forest.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.e_goblin_hunt.d: A goblin band is raiding wagons. Put an end to it.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.e_iron_requisit: The Guild needs iron to equip the rookies.
Kobolds have taken over the iron mine tunnels.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.e_night_watch.d: Stand guard through the night and protect the village.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.e_old_mineshaft: Scout the entrance of an abandoned mineshaft for the Guild.
Poison jellies have tainted the village well.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.e_slime_gel.des: The alchemist pays well for fresh slime gel.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.e_village_lette: Deliver a Guild letter to a nearby village.
A horde of undead approaches the village.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.f_coal_delivery: The blacksmith needs coal for this week's orders.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.f_first_steps.d: Every adventurer starts like this: prove you can defend yourself.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.f_first_trial.d: Request your first Elemental Trial (Paths tab, in the B menu) and come out victorious.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.f_goblin_scouts: Goblins have been spotted lurking by the village road.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.f_herb_gatherin: The apothecary needs flowers and seeds for remedies.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.f_lumber_reques: The Guild hall is being renovated and needs timber.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.f_slime_cull.de: Slimes are invading the crops. Thin them out.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.f_spider_nest.d: A farmer complains about spiders in the barn.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.f_tavern_suppli: The tavern next to the Guild ran out of bread.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.f_winter_wool.d: The orphanage needs blankets before the cold arrives.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.guild_v8_border: The Kingdom hired the Guild to clear the Horde from around the cities.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.guild_v8_capita: The Guild's headquarters is in Aldória, the Capital. Every adventurer should see it.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.guild_v8_city_t: Every city in the Kingdom has a Guild branch. Visit a new one.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.guild_v8_counte: Interrupt two enemy castings with a Counterspell before they complete.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.guild_v8_fairy_: Become the Horde's terror in the woods. The fairies will sing your name.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.guild_v8_forest: Goblins and orcs hunt fairies in the forests. The Wildfolk pay for the escort.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.guild_v8_plant_: The Wildfolk ask the Guild to replant the cleared groves.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.guild_v8_reacti: The Guild's instructors want to see you combine elements in combat.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.guild_v8_refore: A whole forest to give back what was taken from the land.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.guild_v8_teamwo: Hire an adventurer and fight together. Nobody ranks up alone.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.kingdom_arrow_s: The wall towers are almost out of arrows.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.kingdom_bread_s: Soldiers don't fight on empty stomachs. Deliver bread to the quartermaster.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.kingdom_city_wa: The guard is stretched thin. Clear the monsters that get inside the walls — and win back the Kingdom's trust.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.kingdom_goblin_: By the Lord's Order: the Goblin King
The Lord demands the Goblin King's head. The reward is generous.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.kingdom_heroes_: The Horde must learn to fear the Kingdom's name. Lead the counterattack.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.kingdom_hobgobl: Hobgoblins lead the Horde's raids. Cut off the serpent's head.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.kingdom_horde_r: Horde bands raid the farms near the cities. Drive them off.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.kingdom_iron_su: The royal forge needs iron for the guard's new spears.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.kingdom_night_p: Join the night patrol and slay whatever comes out of the dark.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.kingdom_orc_lor: By the Lord's Order: the Orc Lord
The Orc Lord dared to claim the Kingdom's lands. Show him his mistake.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.kingdom_orc_war: An orc warband marches on the border. Stop it before it reaches the villages.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.kingdom_outpost: Illagers threaten the Kingdom's roads. Bring down their outpost.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.kingdom_raid_br: The illagers are organizing. Break their strength before the raid.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.kingdom_royal_m: Carry a letter from the Lord to a city you haven't visited yet.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.kingdom_wall_de: Monsters prowl the gates every night. Protect the citizens inside the city.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.s_abyss_soverei: The throne of the Abyss must fall.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.s_deep_warden.d: Something blind and terrible guards the ancient city.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.s_elemental_par: Have rank V or higher Trials cleared in four different elements.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.s_last_lich.des: Find the phylactery. End what began centuries ago.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.s_legendary_ars: The Guild will equip its S-rank heroes.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.s_seraph_fall.d: The Seraph went mad and sealed the gates of Heaven.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.s_trial_archmag: Clear a rank VII Trial: the Guardian and the Avatar fight together.
Clear a rank VI or higher Trial.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.s_twilight_hera: The end of all things has a face. Stare it down.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.s_twilight_rift: Enter the rift where the world ends.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.trial_a.desc: Defeat an Elemental Guardian in its temple.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.trial_a_chamber: Clear a rank IV or higher Trial.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.trial_b: Rank B Trial: The Orc Lord
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.trial_b.desc: Defeat the Orc Lord in his camp.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.trial_b_alt.des: Defeat an elder guardian in its monument.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.trial_b_chamber: Clear a rank III or higher Trial.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.trial_c: Rank C Trial: The Goblin King
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.trial_c.desc: Storm the Goblin Fortress and defeat the Goblin King.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.trial_c_chamber: Clear a rank II or higher Trial.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.trial_d: Rank D Trial: The King Slime
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.trial_d.desc: Defeat the King Slime without running away.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.trial_d_alt.des: Clear the surroundings of skeletons and creepers.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.trial_d_chamber: Clear an Elemental Trial of any rank.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.trial_e.desc: Show the Master you've mastered basic combat.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.trial_e_alt.des: Protect the village from the undead through the night.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.trial_s.desc: Defeat one of the sovereigns of the Abyss or of Heaven.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.trial_s_alt.des: Defeat the Ender Dragon or the Warden.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.trial_s_chamber: Clear a rank VI or higher Trial.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.underworld_evok: Two evokers know too much. They should know nothing anymore.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.underworld_gold: "Borrow" a desert pyramid's treasure before the Kingdom's archaeologists.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.underworld_hot_: Emeralds of unknown origin. The fence doesn't ask where they came from.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.underworld_king: The Underworld's King wants a legendary trophy and netherite. The pay matches.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.underworld_mans: The woodland mansion keeps valuable secrets. Clear the place out.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.underworld_monu: The ocean monument's gold has a buyer. The guardians don't.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.underworld_nigh: Someone pays well so that certain creatures don't see the dawn. No questions.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.underworld_pill: The pillagers disrupt the smuggling on the roads. Deal with them.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.underworld_rare: A demanding client wants gems and gold. Discretion is the price.
guild_quest.isekai_mahou.underworld_shad: Show you can act unseen: use Shadow magic.
item.isekai_mahou.adventurer_card.blank: Blank card. Get yours from the Guild receptionist.
item.isekai_mahou.adventurer_card.name: Name: %s
item.isekai_mahou.guild_coin.desc: Accepted at the Guild shop and by adventurers.
journal.isekai_mahou.kingdoms.counterspe: When an enemy starts casting something big (it shows on the Stack panel on the left), hit it with a Counterspell glyph before it completes.
"In response..." — and the enemy's spell dissolves in the air.
journal.isekai_mahou.kingdoms.faction_fr: Quests, defending the city and helping out give reputation. See the Reputation tab in the menu (B). At Friendly prices drop and new quests appear.
A smile from the guard, a discount from the merchant. Reputation is currency.
journal.isekai_mahou.kingdoms.faction_qu: Faction Boards stand in the plaza (Kingdom), the Academy tower, the church and a hidden alley (Underworld). Quests unlock with your reputation with the faction.
Every banner has its requests — and its gratitude.
journal.isekai_mahou.kingdoms.hire_adven: Talk to an adventurer (right-click) and choose "Hire". They follow you for 3 days, fight, use their class skill and rank up with kills. Sneak + click: follow/wait.
A good companion is worth more than a new sword.
journal.isekai_mahou.kingdoms.lore: The world isn't made only of monsters and shrines. There are walls, banners and people who remember who helps them — and who betrays them. Kingdom, Academy, Church and even the Underworld have work for someone like you.
journal.isekai_mahou.kingdoms.outro: Your name now runs through the taverns. Some doors open on their own; others not even magic will open.
journal.isekai_mahou.kingdoms.reach_city: The arrow points to the nearest city (the Capital, Aldória, is close to spawn). Walk through the gates: monsters don't spawn inside the walls.
Stone walls, blue banners and the smell of warm bread. Civilization, at last.
Follow the arrow to the city
Soak a target and use Lightning (Electrocute), burn and freeze (Melt), Burning + Lightning (Overload)... Combine different elements on the same enemy.
Water and lightning. Fire and ice. Magic loves combinations.
journal.isekai_mahou.kingdoms.title: Kingdoms and Factions

screen.isekai_mahou.guild.adv.hire_tip2: The price depends on rank and your Guild reputation.
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.adv.title: Adventurer
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.board_empty: No quests on the board today. Come back tomorrow!
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.desk_trial: You can take the promotion trial now. Look for the Guild Master!
The Academy wants data: spells cast, reactions triggered, Trials won.
The Church of the Dawn asks for light against the dead — and offerings for the needy.
The Kingdom pays those who defend the cities, supply the barracks and face the Horde.
No names, no questions. The Underworld pays for night work and rare goods.
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.hunt.offer_des: When accepted, the Guild marks a spot 150–500 blocks away in the creatures' biome. There they come in %s waves; the area's mobs drop essences.
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.master_daily: The Master picks a different trial each day. If this one isn't for you, come back tomorrow.
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.master_max: You've reached the top: Rank S. The legends speak of you now.
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.master_need: You need %s more Guild points for the Rank %s trial. This is the trial that awaits you:
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.master_no_tria: There is no trial available in this world for the next rank.
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.master_offer: You have enough points. Accept the trial to reach Rank %s:
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.master_trial_g: Trial in progress for Rank %s. Complete the objective and come back to report.
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.master_unregis: The Guild Master only receives registered adventurers. Talk to the receptionist first.
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.shop_empty: The shop is closed for inventory.
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.tab_hint: Take and turn in quests at the Quest Board or with the receptionist. Promotion trials are with the Guild Master.
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.tab_unregister: Find the Adventurers' Guild Receptionist (in the Guild village, or behind a Guild Counter) to receive your Adventurer Card and start at Rank F.
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.tip.0: Tip: the board changes at midnight. Sleeping also brings new quests.
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.tip.1: Tip: exploration quests count as soon as you set foot in the place.
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.tip.2: Tip: adventurers around the world buy monster drops for coins.
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.tip.3: Tip: your card shows your rank, points and completed quests.
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.tip.4: Tip: abandoning a quest does not give back its slot on today's board.
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.tip.5: Tip: open the Guild tab in the menu (B) to see your progress anywhere.
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.tip.6: Tip: the promotion trial changes every day. Don't like today's? Come back tomorrow.
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.tip.7: Tip: Elemental Trials (Paths tab, B menu) count toward the Guild's Chamber quests.
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.title: Adventurers' Guild
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.welcome_ranks: Ranks go from F to S. Earn points and pass the Guild Master's trial to be promoted. Higher ranks unlock better quests and rare items in the shop.
screen.isekai_mahou.guild.welcome_text: Here adventurers from all over the world take on requests: hunting monsters, gathering materials, exploring ruins and facing bosses. Every quest grants coins, experience, glyph scrolls and Guild points.
